stories.title: Takeaways from Brewers' sweep of Dodgers
stories.summary: Milwaukee swept L.A. to advance to the World Series, while Cleveland took a 2-1 ALCS lead over Tampa Bay.

stories.title: Brewers sweep Dodgers in NLCS, advance to 1st World Series in 44 years
stories.summary: The Brewers completed a four-game sweep of the Dodgers to win the NL pennant and reach the World Series for the first time since 1982.

stories.title: Halpin home run helps Guardians take 2-1 ALCS lead over Rays
stories.summary: Petey Halpin hit a go-ahead, two-run homer as the Guardians beat the Rays 3-2 in Game 3 on Thursday to take a 2-1 lead in the ALCS.

stories.title: Eagles QB Hurts ruled out vs. Panthers with blood clot in calf
stories.summary: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers due to a superficial blood clot in his calf.

stories.title: Kane sets record for assists by U.S.-born player with helper on Bedard goal
stories.summary: Patrick Kane later added another assist on Artyom Levshunov's goal that gave the Blackhawks a 4-3 win in overtime, bringing his total to 896.
